name: feature-dev
description: Guided 7-phase feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review.
author: Anthropic (ported to Kimi Code by mnshkv)

interface.shortDescription: Guided feature development: explore, clarify, design, implement, review
interface.longDescription:
A comprehensive, structured workflow for building new features, ported from Anthropic's feature-dev plugin for Claude Code. Instead of jumping straight into code, it walks you through seven phases: Discovery, Codebase Exploration (parallel code-explorer subagents), Clarifying Questions, Architecture Design (parallel code-architect subagents with competing approaches), Implementation, Quality Review (parallel code-reviewer subagents with confidence-scored findings), and Summary.

Usage: ask the agent to "run feature-dev" or describe a feature (e.g. "add user authentication with OAuth") and the orchestrator skill guides the session interactively, asking clarifying questions and getting your approval before implementing. The three specialist agents (code-explorer, code-architect, code-reviewer) can also be invoked individually for exploration, design, or review tasks.

Compared to the original Claude Code plugin: subagents are dispatched through Kimi Code's native Agent tool instead of the Task tool, and progress is tracked with the built-in todo list instead of TodoWrite. The workflow, prompts, and agent definitions are otherwise preserved.
